note: ERA5 (Copernicus Climate Data Store) regions read by desks/mt5/research/era5_reader.py. Each region is a small set of representative points (lat, lon, weight) inside the growing or demand area; the region value for a day is the weighted mean over the points that have that day. Fields are the reader's own aggregate names (see era5_reader.FIELDS). `instruments` maps a field to the MT5 symbols it bears on, with a DECLARED PRIOR sign (+1: a high reading is expected to lift the price). The prior is never traded: a direct cell's side is the MEASURED sign of its gain-test IC. `headline` is the field the paid-substitute engine correlates (lake id psub_era5_<region>). `library_region` is the region code the engine scores against paid catalogue rows. Point coordinates are representative locations chosen for the crop belt or demand centre, not a gridded area mean.

dataset.name: reanalysis-era5-single-levels-timeseries
dataset.status: needs-box-confirmation: the dataset name and request shape were written off-box (the CDS host is unreachable from the build container); the first box pass records the CDS reply in reports/ERA5_STATUS.json

regions.label: US Corn Belt (Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Nebraska, Minnesota)
regions.headline: cdd_anom_7d
regions.mechanism: summer heat and dry spells in the Corn Belt cut US corn and soybean yield expectations; a wet, mild season raises them

regions.label: US Southern Plains hard red winter wheat (Kansas, Oklahoma)
regions.headline: precip_anom_30d
regions.mechanism: drought and late freezes over the HRW belt cut winter-wheat condition ratings

regions.label: Brazil coffee belt (Sul de Minas, Cerrado Mineiro, Mogiana, Espirito Santo conilon)
regions.headline: precip_anom_30d
regions.mechanism: frost (Jun-Aug) and dry flowering seasons (Sep-Nov) in Minas Gerais damage the next arabica crop; ES drought hits robusta (conilon)

regions.label: Brazil centre-south cane (Sao Paulo, Goias, Mato Grosso do Sul)
regions.headline: precip_anom_30d
regions.mechanism: a dry, hot centre-south lowers cane yields and ATR, tightening sugar supply

regions.label: West Africa cocoa belt (Cote d'Ivoire, Ghana)
regions.headline: precip_anom_30d
regions.mechanism: a dry, hot main-crop season (and a strong Harmattan) cuts Ivorian and Ghanaian cocoa arrivals

regions.label: Europe gas-demand centres (Germany, France, Italy, Netherlands, UK)
regions.headline: hdd_anom_7d
regions.mechanism: cold European weeks raise heating gas demand and storage draws, pulling US LNG feedgas and Henry Hub with them

regions.label: US gas- and power-demand centres (NY, Boston, Philadelphia, Chicago, Atlanta, Dallas)
regions.headline: hdd_anom_7d
regions.mechanism: heating degree days drive residential/commercial gas burn in winter; cooling degree days drive power burn in summer
